dialogues.speaker: Petit Lumiere
dialogues.text: Wonderful attractions and a wide variety of cinematic themes — it's just like an anthology film! Taking this temp job was absolutely worth it!

choices.text: You're only here on a temporary basis?

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Indeed. As a film director, it's vital to find inspiration in life. Before this, I worked for a while in a shop and even as a blacksmith.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: I may not be able to adjust to certain types of physical labor, but anything to do with the mind is very much in my wheelhouse.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: If you ever need someone to help you come up with ideas, I'm your man!

choices.text: Have you found much inspiration here?

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: Indeed, I have. Much to my surprise — and delight — I've been inspired to try out some new shooting techniques.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: In my previous works, I've tended to employ restrained, static shots to drive the narrative. Doing so strikes a good balance between the atmosphere and the information conveyed.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: However, after observing these attractions and considering the broader flow of your guests' movements, I've come up with some new ideas on how to frame my shots.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: I'm going to try them out in my next film. I'm hoping they lead to some interesting new effects.

choices.text: I'll leave you to your observations.

response.speaker: Petit Lumiere
response.text: It's not just about observing. You also need to consider the reasons behind all the fine details.
